title: Build a Context-Aware Chat Assistant with Memory
summary: Learn how to build a simple AI chat assistant that stores conversation history and sends it back to the model as context. This hands-on quest explores how memory allows the AI to maintain a conversation instead of responding independently.

sections.text: Try this: Load an LLM using a Python library such as Hugging Face Transformers. **Loading the language model is the first required feature to enable your chat assistant.**
Try this: Store conversation history including user messages and AI responses. **Storing conversation history allows the assistant to remember information from previous messages.**
Quest 3: Build Context for Each Prompt

Try this: Combine previous conversation history, add the new user question, and send everything as context to the model. **Injecting the previous conversation as context ensures the model uses past information in future responses.**
Quest 4: Run a Continuous Chat Loop

Try this: Run a continuous chat loop where the user can ask multiple questions, like saying 'My name is Ahmed' and then asking 'What is my name?'. **Observing how memory affects the model's responses shows how context handling works in real Generative AI systems.**

learning_objectives: Load an LLM using a Python library such as Hugging Face Transformers
Build a chat loop where the user can ask multiple questions
Store conversation history and inject it as context in each new prompt
